stories.label: Iran-US nuclear talks in Geneva
stories.summary: Iran-US nuclear talks set for Feb 18 in Geneva. IRGC launched Hormuz drills as leverage signal. Netanyahu demands full dismantlement. Araghchi met IAEA chief.

stories.label: Iran anti-regime protest movement
stories.summary: Massive diaspora rallies Feb 15 followed by anti-regime chants heard inside Tehran. Movement repressed after January peak but showing signs of life.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia Geneva peace talks
stories.summary: Both sides escalating militarily ahead of Tuesday Geneva talks. Ukraine sending negotiators. Russia downed 345 Ukrainian drones in 24h. Bryansk lost power.

stories.label: Trump Gaza Board of Peace
stories.summary: $5B+ pledged. Inaugural meeting Feb 19. Albania, Romania attending. Indonesia preparing up to 8,000 peacekeeping troops. Trump urging Hamas disarmament.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire under strain
stories.summary: Israel struck near Lebanon-Syria border killing 4, claiming to target Islamic Jihad. First claimed strike on IJP since Nov 2024 ceasefire. Threatens truce.

stories.label: Israel ultra-Orthodox conscription crisis
stories.summary: Hundreds of ultra-Orthodox men chased female IDF soldiers in Bnei Brak, flipped police car, injured 3 officers. 23 arrested. Supreme Court ruled Haredim can be drafted in 2024.

stories.label: European defence autonomy push
stories.summary: Munich Security Conference produced joint German-UK military chiefs' call for rearmament. Von der Leyen said 'lines crossed that cannot be uncrossed.' EU mutual defence pact advancing.

stories.label: Sudan compounding humanitarian crisis
stories.summary: AU summit declared world's worst crisis. RSF courts issuing stoning sentences. Second ferry sinking. Camp fires killing children. 11M+ displaced. Covered two consecutive cycles.

stories.label: Global AI model race and governance
stories.summary: India AI Impact Summit ongoing with Modi, world leaders. Alibaba released Qwen-3.5. UK fast-tracking child safety regulation. Three angles converging: competition, governance, safety.

stories.label: Scientific brain drain to China
stories.summary: Brain Prize-winning neuroscientist Arthur Konnerth left Germany's Technical University of Munich for Shenzhen Bay Laboratory in China. Signals deepening talent competition.

stories.label: Pakistan PTI sit-in over Imran Khan
stories.summary: PTI sit-in entering fourth day. KP cut off from rest of country. SC ordered medical exam but PTI rejected it. Roads to Parliament cleared but protest continues.

stories.label: Myanmar-ASEAN war crimes standoff
stories.summary: East Timor became first ASEAN member to accuse Myanmar of war crimes. Junta expelled East Timor envoy. Breaks bloc's non-interference tradition.

stories.label: Nepal post-uprising election
stories.summary: Campaigning underway for March 5 parliamentary election, first since anti-corruption protests toppled previous government. Ousted PM Oli seeking return.

stories.label: US Venezuela oil blockade enforcement
stories.summary: US forces boarded another tanker in Indian Ocean after tracking it from Caribbean. Enforcing Trump's Venezuela blockade. Second boarding incident.

stories.label: Navalny death European investigation
stories.summary: Five European countries accused Russia of killing Navalny with dart frog toxin. Kremlin rejected accusations as 'not based on anything.'
